verdict.rationale: Jeeves documents its own developer API covering transactions and expense data, including a transactions query endpoint. That lets developers view accounting-relevant spend data programmatically. However, nothing shows a dedicated accounting API for managing accounting records such as GL accounts, categories, coding, or sync state; the NetSuite/QuickBooks/Xero sync is an integration, not an API. Missing for 10: a dedicated accounting API, write/manage operations on accounting data, an accessible API spec (OpenAPI probes returned 404), and independent corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can view and manage accounting data through a dedicated API

citations.quote: API Platform: Developer APIs for cards, payments, transactions, and expense data.
Use POST /v1/cards/transactions with the source field to query card or travel transactions in a single endpoint.
